description: Use this when the organizer wants to change a sheet made with create_signup_sheet: add slots, change a slot's label or capacity, remove an empty slot, change the per-person limit, show or hide names, edit the note, or close and reopen sign-ups. Takes the organizer link and only the changes. A capacity cannot go below the people already signed up, and a slot with sign-ups cannot be removed. Does not notify participants.

add_slots.description: New slots added at the end, e.g. [{"label": "Ice", "capacity": 1}].

capacity.description: How many people this slot takes, 1-50. Default 1. Example: 3.

end.description: Optional end: HH:MM the same day (e.g. 12:00), or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or for a date slot the last day YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: What people sign up for, e.g. Main dish, Saturday 9-12 shift, Car seat to the game.

start.description: Optional local start YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or a date YYYY-MM-DD, in time_zone, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:00.

slot.description: The slot to change: its label or its number in the results, e.g. Salad or 2.

manage_url.description: The private organizer link returned when the sheet was created, e.g. https://signup-sheet.zovo.one/m/AbC.../XyZ.... The public link (/p/...) does not work here.

max_per_person.description: How many slots one person may take, 1-60. Default 1. Example: 2.

note.description: Short note shown on the sheet, e.g. Please bring serving spoons.

remove_slots.description: Labels or numbers of empty slots to remove, e.g. ["Ice"].

show_names.description: Show first names on each slot to everyone with the link (helps avoid duplicate dishes). Default false. Example: true.

sign_ups.description: close stops new sign-ups; reopen allows them again. Example: close.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for slot dates and times, e.g. America/Chicago. Needed when any slot has a start.

title.description: Sheet title, e.g. Thanksgiving potluck or Food drive volunteer shifts.

name: update_signup_sheet
title: Update sign-up sheet
